name: redbridge-workspace
description: npm front door for the .NET build. Each script runs the dotnet or git command it wraps; tools/dotnet.mjs finds the SDK.

scripts.build: node tools/dotnet.mjs build src/REDbridge/REDbridge.csproj -c Release --no-restore -m:1 -p:UseSharedCompilation=false -nodeReuse:false -v q
scripts.build:full: npm run restore && npm run build
scripts.clean: node tools/dotnet.mjs clean src/REDbridge/REDbridge.csproj -c Release -v q
scripts.release: gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f release=true
